scope: Independent source-faithfulness and contribution-strength review of actual final DOCX text and references53/54; not new literature discovery or model/material validation.

checks.name: Exact final main and SI document identities
Reference53 journal year volume article DOI and six authors match primary indexed metadata
Reference54 explicitly identifies actual arXivv4,2026 and five authors rather than a peer-reviewed journal
Wang domain statement accurately describes hydrogel constitutive identification from stress histories

limitations: Bounded literature discovery cannot prove absolute absence of exact duplication.
